verdict.rationale: Stripe documents an official CLI (docs.stripe.com/stripe-cli) that serves its crypto and stablecoin offering. The docs show agent-friendly commands such as `stripe sandbox create`, which provisions an anonymous sandbox with working API keys and no account registration. missing for 10: evidence of CLI commands or workflows specific to crypto/stablecoin resources (payments, payouts, onramp), detailed CLI documentation within the pack, independent or hands-on corroboration of CLI use for this product area.
